regions.merged_text: Three Degrees of Tallent; Physical, Intel- lectual, Rational or That no grace is given to men but as a fruit of prayer, is the teaching of many fathers & doctors of the Church, e.g. SS. Basil, Augustine, Jerome, Ambrose, Bernard, etc. "die Liebe zu Gott mit Verachtung der Selbstsucht gründete de himlische Stadt; und die Selbstliebe mit Verachtung Gottes gründete die irdische."

regions.merged_text: Feast of Purification 1900 A.D. God Present. "If Directors are not men of prayer, " says S. Teresa, Their learning will avail little; for many go astray by wishing to have the Spirit of God in their minds without try- ing to possess it in their hearts. "Forsake all and thou shalt find all; re- linquish desire & thou shalt fine rest." Imitation Book III-32 "Quaerite legendo et invenietis meditando; pulsate orando et aperietur vobis contem- plando" S. Bernard "The poor stretch forth the hand; but God receives what is offered." St. Peter Chrysologus (+450 aged 35 C & E.D. )
